sahneler.metin: In a violent storm, the world's largest semi-submersible rig capsized.
The crew abandoned it, and all eighty four men died.
It started with one broken porthole.
Seawater flooded the ballast control panel.
The panel shorted, and valves began acting on their own.
The rig tilted forward, and water entered its chain lockers.
Rig ballast systems, training and survival gear were improved.

aciklama:
Ocean Ranger capsized in a storm off Newfoundland. The cause: seawater shorting the ballast control panel, followed by wrong ballast valve operation and flooding.
